content.value_statement: Reactive Python notebooks can be hard to structure and debug. This skill guides marimo cells, UI elements, data workflows, and app deployment.
actual_capabilities: Explains marimo cell structure and reactive execution rules.
Guides creation of sliders, tables, forms, chat inputs, and custom widgets.
Shows patterns for pandas, Polars, DuckDB, SQL, and plotting workflows.
Helps debug dependency cycles, stale UI values, and notebook execution issues.
Supports notebook-to-app layouts, script execution, and deployment guidance.
Points to focused reference files for marimo APIs and common recipes.
limitations: It does not install marimo or project dependencies by itself.
Generated notebook code still needs local testing with the user data.
Private database, API, and deployment settings require user-provided credentials.
Future marimo API changes may require checking current upstream documentation.

use_cases.title: Create an interactive analysis notebook
use_cases.description: Build a marimo notebook with clean cells, reactive controls, data tables, and charts.

use_cases.title: Convert a prototype into a data app
use_cases.description: Turn notebook outputs into an app layout with forms, tabs, sidebars, and deployment commands.

use_cases.title: Debug reactive notebook behavior
use_cases.description: Diagnose stale values, circular dependencies, redeclared variables, and expensive reruns.

prompt_templates.title: Start a notebook
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a marimo notebook for exploring a CSV file. Include clear cells for imports, loading, filters, and charts.

prompt_templates.title: Add interactive controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Add marimo UI controls to this notebook. Use reactive values correctly and keep each widget separate from cells that read its value.

prompt_templates.title: Debug notebook reactivity
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this marimo notebook for reactivity problems. Identify redeclarations, cycles, mutation issues, and cells that should be stopped or cached.

prompt_templates.title: Design a deployed app
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a marimo app from this analysis workflow. Include layout choices, SQL or dataframe patterns, deployment steps, and validation checks.

output_examples.input: Create a marimo notebook for sales data exploration.
output_examples.output: A cell-by-cell notebook plan with imports, data loading, filters, charts, summary tables, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: My marimo slider value does not update another chart.
output_examples.output: A diagnosis of widget placement, value access, cell dependencies, and a corrected reactive structure.

output_examples.input: Turn this notebook into an internal dashboard.
output_examples.output: A deployment-oriented plan covering app layout, user controls, data connections, checks, and run commands.

best_practices: Keep widget definitions separate from cells that read widget values.
Use descriptive global names and local underscore variables to avoid collisions.
Test generated notebooks with marimo checks before sharing or deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not redeclare the same variable across multiple marimo cells.
Do not rely on hidden execution order from Jupyter notebooks.
Do not hardcode production secrets or database credentials in notebooks.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps create, debug, and deploy marimo notebooks and apps with reactive Python patterns.

faq.question: Can it convert Jupyter notebooks?
faq.answer: It can guide conversion patterns, but the converted notebook should be reviewed and tested locally.

faq.question: Does it run marimo commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and command suggestions that the user or agent must choose to run.

faq.question: Does it support data apps?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for layouts, UI controls, SQL, dataframe displays, and app deployment.

faq.question: How should secrets be handled?
faq.answer: Use environment variables, secret managers, or secure deployment settings instead of hardcoded notebook values.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
